stories.title: 'Miracle on Mississippi' - All passengers rescued after New Orleans cruise ship collision
stories.body: The collision leaves 32 people in hospital with non-critical injuries, but no-one unaccounted for.

stories.title: Microsoft 'deeply sorry' for global outage after almost 24 hours of disruption
stories.body: Experts say the event is a "stark reminder" of how heavily the world relies on a small group of big tech providers.

stories.title: Why is Microsoft's outage lasting so long and will emails be lost?
stories.body: Microsoft says it is continuing to restore services including Outlook and Teams following a global outage.

stories.title: Watch: How a server outage took down Microsoft Teams and Outlook
stories.body: A Microsoft outage is affecting services including Teams, Outlook and AI software Copilot.

stories.title: Setback for SpaceX Starship rocket's double-catch test
stories.body: Elon Musk’s company aborted an attempted catch of the rocket’s booster - instead it came down in the ocean.

stories.title: Rosenberg: Uncompromising Putin ups demands for peace with Ukraine
stories.body: The fact the question of European security now features in discussions is viewed in Moscow as a victory, BBC Russia Editor Steve Rosenberg says.

stories.title: Nvidia scandal fallout widens as Trump's treasury secretary blames cabinet colleague
stories.body: Scott Bessent suggests Howard Lutnick’s commerce department failed to ban exports of Nvidia's chips to a firm thought to have links with China.

stories.title: The Peruvian city that has embraced Pope Leo as one of its own
stories.body: Pope Leo XIV is in Peru as part of his Latin America tour, just weeks after having surgery for lung cancer.

stories.title: German spies handed new powers to tackle 'hybrid threats' from abroad
stories.body: German reforms mean foreign and domestic intelligence services will have greater powers to combat espionage, terrorism and sabotage.

stories.title: Democratic Senate leader Schumer set to face leadership challenge
stories.body: Maryland Senator Van Hollen says "new leadership" is needed for Democrats following the party's recent midterm successes.

stories.title: Aide to fugitive Ukrainian ex-PM wounded in latest Moscow car bombing
stories.body: Sergei Zavorotny, now a journalist and commentator, was previously an adviser to Ukrainian ex-prime minister Mykola Azarov.

stories.title: Rosalía scoops historic third best album award at Latin Grammys
stories.body: The Spanish singer is recognised for her fourth album Lux which was released last year to rave reviews.

stories.title: African Miss Universe beauty queens in limbo as US visa restrictions bite
stories.body: Hall has been seeking a US visa in South Africa as other African beauty queens face similar hurdles.

stories.title: At least 24 killed after bus collides with truck in north-east India
stories.body: Several of the deceased are college students, according to local official Atul Bora, but they have not yet been publicly identified.

stories.title: Watch: Cruise ship seen sinking after collision with cargo ship in New Orleans
stories.body: All passengers have been accounted for after a cargo ship collided with a docked cruise ship.

stories.title: Watch: Divers explore US ship sunk off Florida coast to create new reef
stories.body: The ship was intentionally sunk off the coast of Florida in order to create the world's largest artificial ocean reef.

stories.title: Will the Eurovision Song Contest succeed in Asia?
stories.body: The world’s biggest and longest-running song contest is coming to Asia, with eleven countries competing in Bangkok, Thailand on Saturday.

stories.title: Military cemetery decorum: The tradition behind Hegseth's Veterans Day reprimand
stories.body: BBC's Bernd Debusmann breaks down why Defence Secretary Hegseth's group was reprimanded at Arlington National Cemetery and the history behind its strict rules of conduct.

stories.title: 'We've got to run': Inside ruined Ukraine power plant under constant drone threat
stories.body: Dan Johnson visits one of the country's largest power stations, barely left standing after a ballistic missile strike by Russia.

stories.title: Hegseth and advisers reprimanded by guard at Tomb of the Unknown Soldier
stories.body: Following a ceremony marking Veterans Day, a group that included Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth was shouted at to be quiet.
